comparison.objective: Withdraw an index latch and stow a footrest, not set a gripper opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold/release a latch while swinging and capturing an articulated footrest.
comparison.success_condition: Footrest reaches the stowed capture state after the required unlocking; numeric bands are absent from the body.
comparison.reason: Articulation through an index latch differs from precision threaded adjustment and repeated retention testing.
